headline: MTN Nigeria 9-Month Cash Income Tax Payments Surge to N295.4B
summary: MTN Nigeria Communications paid N295.4 billion in income tax during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up 1,271% from N21.5 billion in the prior-year period.
why: MTN Nigeria is the largest telecommunications provider in Nigeria and one of the most capitalized equities on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc
impacts.why: Substantially higher cash tax outflows weigh on net corporate cash balances.
